reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks the car to pull forward out of the dark, a performed behavior that overrides the storyboard’s static pose.
reasons.medium: No reference has authority over the rendering medium, and the brief supplies no rendering-style instruction, so the medium remains request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, and the reference has no wardrobe authority, so wardrobe remains request-governed.
reasons.lighting: No reference has lighting authority, and the brief’s darkness describes a scene condition rather than an illuminating source, direction, or visible light quality; lighting is therefore request-governed.
reasons.framing: The storyboard reference is permitted to govern framing, and the brief does not request any camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or camera movement; motion and canvas aspect do not constitute framing instructions.
reasons.palette: No reference has palette authority, and the brief does not explicitly request a color grade, hue change, saturation, or contrast treatment; palette therefore remains request-governed.
